name: swarna-prabha
description: Swarna Prabha — a deterministic, no-LLM jewellery marketplace (React + Vite client, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL API).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
